title: The three central faces of a duplicated first repeat
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $I$ a linearly ordered type, $U:I\to\mathrm{Opens}(X)$ an open family [def-sc-zariski-site], $F$ an abelian-group presheaf, and $S$ a chosen terminal-open Čech product complex [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Let $p\ge0$, $s\in S^{p+1}(F)$, $t:\{0,\ldots,p+1\}\to I$, and $a\in\{0,\ldots,p+1\}$ satisfy the first-repeat predicate [def-pc-alternating-cech-sorting-operators]: $t_a=t_{a+1}$ and $t_b<t_{b+1}$ for every $b<a$. Let $q:\{0,\ldots,p+2\}\to\{0,\ldots,p+1\}$ duplicate position $a$, so $q(k)=k$ for $k\le a$ and $q(k)=k-1$ otherwise, and let $\delta_j$ omit position $j$. Write $\alpha^*$ for the index map of $S$. Then $\sum_{j=a}^{a+2}(-1)^a(-1)^j F(q^*)F(\delta_j^*)\bigl(s_{tq\delta_j}\bigr)=s_t$. No monotonicity hypothesis on the rest of $t$ is required.

source.place: Tag 01FM, equation-second-homotopy (20.23.6.2), and the verification omitted immediately after it

proof.text:
Duplication at the first repeat turns the equal entries at a and a+1 into
three equal entries at a,a+1,a+2. Deleting any of them gives t again. The composite
restriction is the identity after this tuple equality, since Opens is a thin
category. Thus the three transported sections all equal s(t). Their coefficients
are (-1)^a times (-1)^a, (-1)^(a+1), and (-1)^(a+2), respectively. The first
and third are 1 and the middle is -1, so their sum is 1. All other summands
are excluded by the filter.

lean.statement: theorem cechRepeatCentralFaces (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type v} [LinearOrder I] (U : I → X.Opens) (F : X.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{w}) (S : SiteCechComplex U (fun i ↦ homOfLE (le_top : U i ≤ ⊤))) (p : ℕ) (s : S.cochains F (p + 1)) (t : Fin (p + 2) → I) (a : Fin (p + 2)) (ha : cechFirstRepeat t a) : let q := cechJunction (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _) a (∑ j : Fin (p + 3), if a.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val ≤ a.val + 2 then ((-1 : ℤ) ^ a.val * (-1 : ℤ) ^ j.val) • F.map (S.indexMap t q).op (F.map (S.indexMap (t ∘ q) j.succAbove).op (s ((t ∘ q) ∘ j.succAbove))) else 0) = s t
